answer: Unfortunately, no. Northwind's home pickup service, where a specialist comes to your home or office to inspect the car and complete the sale, isn't available in Texas. You can still sell your car by getting an instant offer online with your VIN or license plate and then booking an appraisal appointment at a store. If your car doesn't run, select stores will tow it to the store at no charge, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing.
